title: Lulu and the Bubbles | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Lulu the little duck blows bubbles with her bubble wand. Pip the kitten hops and pops them, and a big, big bubble floats over to Bunny.
Then the sun goes down and the three friends fall asleep while one last little bubble floats up into the night sky.
A gentle, playful story for children aged 3 to 6.
